training.prefix_path: frozen eval/no_grad B1, same producer for A1/A2

new_pool.source: deterministic recorded-frame replay from historical target-training samples, new unique arrival ID each time
new_pool.arrival_visibility: independent host producer at fixed nominal times; training admits queued arrivals at step boundaries; ready and visible timestamps recorded

replay_pool.source: historical data_split replay_windows, deduplicated by episode/start for storage
replay_pool.warmup: all unique replay prefixes computed and pinned before streaming; then full recent pool warmup before measured windows

A1: new first sampled prefix computation + pinned store; subsequent hits shared async H2D
A2: new arriving prefix copied from precomputed producer payload into receiver pinned storage; replay same as A1

cost_boundary.producer: precomputed recorded service-path payloads; cost excluded per user; prior export effect +0.33ms P99 retained as prior evidence
cost_boundary.receiver: CPU host allocation, copy/store, sampling/batch assembly, cache turnover and H2D measured
cost_boundary.network: no network transport emulated; producer payload already available in host RAM

k: complete lifetime cohorts born and evicted within measurement; sample_count includes zero; all arrival lifetimes retained
queue: do not preempt learning; formal streaming gated on combined primary learning results and successful smoke test
